Name: Kenneth's All Crops Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Kenneth's All Crops Addon[/b]

[b]Tired of hunting for seeds every season? This addon adds ALL vanilla crops directly to Kenneth's Grocery Store![/b]

[b]What it does:[/b]
[b]🛒 41 Vanilla Crops added to Kenneth's Grocery Store (Shop 1) - all available year-round![/b]
[b]🍎 If you have Kenneth's Fruit Shop, all fruit crops also appear there[/b]
[b]🥕 If you have Kenneth's Vegetable Shop, all vegetable crops also appear there[/b]
[b]💰 Premium price for convenience, but available all year round in Kenneth's shops![/b]

[b]Includes:[/b]
[b]Parsnip, Green Bean, Cauliflower, Potato, Kale, Rhubarb, Melon, Tomato, Blueberry, Hot Pepper, Wheat, Radish, Red Cabbage, Starfruit, Corn, Eggplant, Artichoke, Pumpkin, Bok Choy, Yam, Cranberry, Beet, Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Apple, Pomegranate, Banana, Mango, Summer Squash, Broccoli, Powdermelon, Ancient Fruit, Cactus Fruit, Pineapple, Grape, Sweet Gem Berry, Qi Fruit, and more![/b]

[b]Vegetable version includes: Parsnip, Green Bean, Cauliflower, Potato, Kale, Rhubarb, Tomato, Hot Pepper, Wheat, Radish, Red Cabbage, Corn, Eggplant, Artichoke, Pumpkin, Bok Choy, Yam, Beet, Hops, Tea Leaves, Unmilled Rice.[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Grocery Store (Required)[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Fruit Shop (Optional)[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Vegetable Shop (Optional)[/b]
[b]• Content Patcher[/b]

[b]Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla crops in Kenneth's shops![/b]
